name: Entropic Float: This World Will Decay and Disappear
source:
Entropic Float is a visual novel regarding the experiences of fourteen people who've been trapped inside a magical construct known as the Anomalous Clocktower. Missing memories of how they came to be there, certain aspects of their past life, and of course, every loop but the current one, can those who awakened inside the Anomaly find a way out?

Step into the shoes of Rashmi Jamil, Kanatsun, and Amelie Macon at different times of day as you seek a resolution. In each loop, you'll also be challenged to make the right decisions to overcome Entropy, in the hopes that the protagonists' memories might make it through to another version of themselves if the loop doesn't end in tragedy. After finding all eighteen common endings, will the path to truth finally open before you?
translation:
《Entropic Float》是一部视觉小说，讲述了十四个人被困在一个名为“异常钟楼”的神奇建筑内的经历。失去了他们如何来到那里的记忆，他们过去生活的某些方面，当然，还有除了当前循环之外的每一个循环，那些在异常中醒来的人能找到出路吗？

在一天中的不同时间，扮演Rashmi Jamil、Kanasun和Amelie Macon的角色，寻求解决方案。在每个循环中，你还将面临做出正确决定来克服熵的挑战，希望如果循环没有以悲剧结束，主角的记忆可能会进入他们自己的另一个版本。找到全部十八个共同结局后，通往真理的道路终于在你面前敞开了吗？
